key_concepts: An element is a pure substance containing only one kind of atom.
Elements cannot be separated into simpler materials except during nuclear reactions.
Over 100 existing elements are listed and classified on the periodic table.
A compound is a pure substance containing two or more kinds of atoms chemically combined.
Atoms in compounds often form groups called molecules.
